source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: ...of the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Sergeant at Arms directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Pia Cayetano.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Let us bow our heads. Almighty God, we come before you today seeking your wisdom and guidance as we carry our duties.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: We

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: lift up to you every Filipino family, especially those struggling with rising cost of living, those affected by calamities, and those facing uncertainty about their future. Grant us wisdom to make sound decisions, humility to listen, courage to do what is right, and compassion for those whose voices are often unheard. Remind us that beyond our differences, we share a common purpose to serve our country, protect the welfare of our people, and build a better future for every Filipino. We entrust our nation and our people to your loving care. In Jesus' name we pray. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Roll call of members. Senator Judge Aquino.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Sen. Judge Cayetano Alan, Sen. Judge Cayetano Pia, Sen. Judge De La Rosa, Sen. Judge Ejercito, Sen. Judge Estrada, Sen. Judge Go, Sen. Judge Hontiveros, Sen. Judge Lacson, Sen. Judge Lapid, Sen. Judge Legarda, Sen. Judge Marcoleta, Sen. Judge Marcos, Sen. Judge Padilla, Sen. Judge Pangilinan, Sen. Judge Sotto III, Sen. Judge Tulfo Erwin, Sen. Judge Tulfo Raffy, Senator Judge Villanueva, Senator Judge Villar Camille, Senator Judge Villar Mark, Senator Judge Zubiri, The Presiding Officer, Senator Judge Escudero, The Senate President, Senator Judge Gatchalian.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With 13 Senator Judges present, the Chair declares the presence of a quorum.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: In accordance with the rules of procedure on impeachment trials, the Chair now recognizes the duly presiding officer to preside over the proceedings of the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Senate President. If there are no objections, we shall dispense with the reading of the November 10, 2026 Journal of the Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, and consider the same as approved.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The clerk will please call the case before the impeachment court.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Case number 004-2026 in the matter of impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Appearances of the parties.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Magandang umaga po. Same appearances for the prosecution, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Ridon, who will handle the next witness?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Depends on the next witness, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The next witness is Atty. Punay.

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: It will be Atty. Kapunan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: that case, Atty. Kapunan, good morning. Atty. Sheila, appearances for the respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honor. Same appearance for the respondent accused. I will ask the court to acknowledge Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular for the examination of our witness, Atty. Balucanag Punay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, good morning.

turns.speaker: Atty. Sheila C. Sison
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And again, good morning, Atty. Lorna. Kindly call your witness, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Good

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: morning, Your Honor. Thank you. For the next witness, Your Honor, may we respectfully call to the witness stand, Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay is hereby directed to situate herself with the assistance of the Secretariat to the witness stand. As soon as she is so situated, the clerk is directed to administer the oath. After the oath, Attorney Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Ma'am, please raise your right hand. You, Suzette Balucanag-Punay, do swear that the evidence you shall give in the case now pending between the Philippines and Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. So help you God.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I do.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly sit down, Attorney Suzette. Atty. Suzette, naunawaan niyo po ay inyong pinanumpaan kaugnay sa pagbibigay niyo ng inyong testimonya sa hukumang ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, ma'am. And good morning, ma'am. Yes, Atty. Justin, what is it? May I proceed? I

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: was actually going to ask for the flashing of the purposes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, kindly make your offer, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. We'll proceed, Your Honor. Good morning, Your Honor. We are offering the testimony of our next witness, Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay for the following purposes. Number one, to prove that she is the in-house counsel of both GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corporation. Number two, to prove that GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corporation are duly organized and existing domestic corporations under Philippine law. and that they are legally engaged in the operation of fast food restaurant chains pursuant to their respective franchise agreements with Jollibee and Chowking respectively. Number three,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: may we request the tech to flash the next slide. Thank you. To prove that the vice president is neither a stockholder, officer, director, of GenCorp Industries Inc., and that she made no capital contribution to the corporation or its Jollibee franchise operations, and that, contrary to the findings of Attorney Alexander B. Cabrera in his reported forensic report, she, and I'm referring to the Vice President, has no ownership or equity interest in said corporation. Number four,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: to

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: prove. The factual inaccuracies and errors specifically in respect to Table 39 of the purported forensic report supposedly prepared by Attorney Alexander B. Cabrera, particularly his computation of the Vice President's purported total undeclared income from GenCorp Industries Inc. and that the same is unsupported by the corporate records and does not accurately reflect The actual income attributable to the Vice President from GenCorp Industries, Inc. Number 5. To prove that the Vice President exercises no control over, no participation in, or supervisory role over the management and business operations of GenCorp Industries, Inc. or in any of its contracts with the government. Number 6.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: To prove the true nature of the Vice President's interest in GenCorp Industries, Inc.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Number seven.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: To prove that, although the Vice President is a stockholder of record and is listed as a director and a member of the Compensation Committee of Metro City Chow Foods Corporation, she has neither participated in nor exercised the functions, duties, and responsibilities pertaining to these positions and that she exercises no control over nor does she participate in or supervise the management and operations of the corporation. And number eight, finally, to disprove and controvert the material allegations under Article 2 of the Articles of Impeachment and the Forensic Report supposed. Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera, to identify documents and other matters related to the foregoing, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Comment, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Good morning, Your Honors.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Good morning again.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Good morning, Counsel. Good morning, Attorney. Good morning.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Good morning, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: A comment on the offer of purpose for which this witness is being presented, Your Honor. On the first your honor, offer,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: The Counsel for Defense mentions that this witness is in-house counsel. Not a comment, Your Honor, but may we be clarified because she is being presented as in-house counsel of both Metro Company and GenCorp. May we know from counsel, Madam, Mr. Presiding Officer, can the Presiding Officer please inquire from counsel? or the witness herself, if she is authorized by virtue of any board resolution from any or both of these companies to testify in today's hearing, Your Honor. To us, this is very important because otherwise, if she is not duly authorized by a board resolution from both companies, we will question her capacity.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: capacity to even appear before this honorable tribunal and more so to testify on behalf of both companies absent a duly authorized board certificate, a secretary certificate from both companies specifically indicating that she is authorized not only to represent the company, both companies, but to appear today in this impeachment trial, and not only to appear and testify, but to identify documents pertaining to these two companies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What is your basis, Attorney Lorna, in asking for a board resolution?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, because we all know we're all... The board resolution is important because we do not want... This is not to preempt the testimony of the witness, Your Honor, but we do not want at some point in time that she will call to the attention of the honorable presiding officer or hide behind the lawyer-client privilege, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Just a brief response, of course. Respectful response to the point raised by the good counsel of the prosecution. First, Your Honor, her appearance today is by virtue of a subpoena, Your Honor. In other words, her appearance today is in compliance with the authority of this honorable court. And number two, Your Honor, I think we need to record that a lawyer has an implied authority to represent the client. But in any case, Your Honor, if the concerns of... The good counsel from the prosecution is to hide behind supposedly the veil of lawyer-client privilege. It is, number one, a premature objection. Number two, it is not an objection that she is entitled to raise and only the corporate clients can raise that. But number three, Your Honor, in any case, the witness will be under oath in respect to her answers, Your Honor. And finally, Your Honor, I would just like to point for the record and it is best for us to recall. When the bank representatives were being presented who represented corporations by virtue of subpoena, no issue with respect to authority was ever raised. That is all, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please, on the last point, with reference to the bank officials, Your Honor, as regards their authority to represent the banks upon a subpoena by this honorable court, Your Honor, It was up to the defense to question the authority of these bank representatives to appear and testify. They did not do so, Your Honor. We are not presuming, Your Honor, the same. We want to know whether this witness really is qualified because she is neither in the general information sheets Her name is not there. And that is why she is being presented today. She is also not in the financial statements of both companies. And that is why she is being presented here today. She also, Your Honor, on the third point, she also, Your Honor, Her name does not appear as well in the articles of incorporation. And that is why when counsel says that she is in-house counsel, it is very important that we have on record a written board resolution authorizing her to appear and testify on behalf. Because even if she is summoned by virtue of subpoena, It does not behood, it may not be a complete authority for her to testify here because she can claim or the companies that she represents here may claim that whatever facts or whatever documents she identifies here is without authority of these companies, Your Honor. And that is why. Just to shorten this proceedings, Your Honor, because this is only the first item in this offer of testimony, Your Honor. May we ask from counsel, in any event, Mr. Presiding Officer, that at some point within the day or within this week, Your Honor, that they present to this honorable Presiding Officer a board resolution or a...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Secretary Certificate affirming her authority to come and speak for the companies, both companies, and to identify records for the companies, Your Honor. May we reserve that

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: right?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: For the meantime, the court will note the... Query and the answer of the counsel for respondent. And kindly continue with your comment on the offer, Attorney Lorna. And the court will make a ruling at the appropriate time, either before we begin after hearing your entire comment and offer, or once the appropriate question has been asked and the objection would come into play once we cross that bridge. So in the meantime, kindly continue with your other comments, if any, to the offer of Attorney Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: We submit, Your Honor. On the second offer, Your Honor, as regards an offer to the effect that GenCorp and Metro Company are duly organized and existing and legally engaged to conduct business for fast food activities, Your Honor, we will stipulate.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As to the second offer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: As to the second offer, Your Honor, as to the due legal existence of Gen. Cor. and Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: May we proceed, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As to

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the third offer, that statement that the Vice President is neither stockholder, director of Gen. Cor. Inc., No capital contribution. Subject to cross-examination, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: On offer number four, as regards the factual table, table 39, with reference to the forensic computation of prosecutors'

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: expert witness, Your Honor. Subject to cross-examination. As well as offer number five, as regards to a statement by counsel, that the Vice President does not exercise any control, participation, or nor any supervision in GenCorp, Your Honor. Subject to cross-examination.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Number six, Your Honor, the nature of her interest in both companies.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Subject to cross-examination. And number seven, to prove that she has no control, the Vice President, over Metro Company, Your Honor. Again, this is subject to cross-examination. And lastly, their blanket offer as to the forensic report submitted by

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Prosecutor's Forensic Expert, Attorney Cabrera, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Subject to cross-examination.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Court will make a ruling on the first one. The court will in the meantime allow the testimony of attorney Punay on her oath as a lawyer upon which she owes candor and fidelity not only to the regular courts but to this court as well. And although corporations cannot act on its own, We as of yet do not know, based on that testimony, if she will be testifying on behalf of the corporation or only about the corporation. But my presumption, Attorney Justin, is given that she is here appearing as in-house counsel of the corporation, that's the corporations, the two corporations. That she waives any privilege in regard to lawyer-client privilege as regards the two corporations, not necessarily the individual stockholders. Would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, unfortunately, as a co-lawyer myself, I cannot answer that question, Your Honor. I think it is best to ask the witness herself with respect to that. At the proper time.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: the proper time, counsel. If and when she invokes it. With a reminder, Attorney Punay, that again, Once you testify as to the two corporations, it would be unfair for you not to invoke the privilege for anything that will favor one side and to invoke the privilege should the question now pertain to evidence you may give against the same side. With that caveat and reminder, the court will allow it. Attorney, Senator Judge Pangalinan is recognized. What is your pleasure, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Just a clarification. On the status of this next witness, I recall, Mr. Presiding Officer, that when Attorney Poa took the witness stand in the previous articles, at some point he was a witness and yet he was also lawyer for the respondent and invoked lawyer-client privilege.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: and refused to answer questions from the senator judges. So, following that precedent, do we expect this witness to likewise invoke that privilege as it has been done by previous witnesses?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: ask this because it would quickly speed up matters if... As earlier raised, that he has been authorized by his clients. He's the in-house counsel of GenCorp and of MetroChao. It would have been simpler if both corporations agreed for their general counsel to testify here and waive lawyer-client privilege. It will save us all a lot of time. So, I'd like that clarified, Mr.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Kiko. Part of the Chair's ruling is that we are presuming, as I said earlier, that she appeared here with the proper authorization on her oath and candor she owes to the Court as an officer of the Court and as a member of the Bar, and that her appearance here is duly authorized, and that Privilege if any between her and the corporation she will be testifying to has been waived by the client and that she cannot choose when to invoke privilege and when not to invoke privilege as to these two clients of hers, the companies. Without prejudice, Atty. Punay, to claiming privilege to the individual shareholders that you may independently have knowledge about as a lawyer. which can be covered by privilege and which we will not compel you to testify in regard to them individually, separately from the companies. Is that understood, Attorney Pune?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly turn on the mic of Senator Judge Kiko.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: With the response of the witness, we can proceed. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Kiko. You may proceed, Attorney Justin, with your direct examination.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Noting the stipulation of the counsel for the prosecutor as to the fact that GenCorp owns several franchises of Jollibee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. We'll keep it in mind. Thank you. Proceeding to my direct examination, Your Honor. Atty. Suzette, maayong buntag.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Good morning.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: For the record, Atty. Suzette, can you please state your name, age, and address to this impeachment court?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Balucanag, Punay, 41 years old. And my office address is 3rd floor, PVL Building, Rizal Street, Corner, Bolton Street, Davao City.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Atty. Suzette, apologies if I have to ask this. What is your profession, if any, Atty. Suzette?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I'm a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And how many years have you been a lawyer, for the record?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: 15 years now.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, Atty. Suzette, you are here in the impeachment court right now. Can you please tell us what you know about this case, if anything at all?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: This is the impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And given that this is the impeachment case against the Vice President, Sara Zimmerman Duterte, can you please tell us what relationship, whether professional or personal, do you have with the Vice President, if anything?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I have no personal or professional relationship with the Vice President.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In that case, how do you know the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am from Davao City, so she was a Mayor and Vice Mayor before.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sinabi niyo kanina, Atty., na aware po kayo ng impeachment case ito ng Vice Presidente. How are you made aware of this impeachment proceeding, if you can recall or if you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It's all over social media.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And Atty. Suzette? Why are you here today?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: By virtue of a subpoena issued to me by the Senate.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Atty. Suzette, what companies are you connected to in relation to this impeachment trial, if you can remember?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am with GenCorp Industries, Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Punahin po natin sinabi niyo po na GenCorp Industries, Inc. May question po. You mentioned that you are with GenCorp Industries, Inc. What is your position in GenCorp Industries, Inc., kung mayroon man?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am their in-house counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And as the in-house counsel of GenCorp Industries, Inc., can you please kindly tell us all what your duties and responsibilities are in said corporation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As in-house counsel, I manage all of their legal inquiries. I also do, I assist them in litigation. I do investigation for employee discipline and I have access to their corporate records.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And can you please tell everyone when you started working for GenCorp Industries Inc po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: In 2022, mid of 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And before that, san po kayo nagtatrabaho kung pwede pong may tanong?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Before, I was with PhilHealth before.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And by PhilHealth, ito po ba yung government institution po? Just a clarification.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, for the record, can you please tell us what you know about, what is GenCorp Industries, Inc.?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp Industries, Inc. is a domestic corporation and its line of business is in the fast food industry.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sinabi niyo po na domestic corporation po itong GenCorp Industries, Inc. My question is, where's the principal address or office address of this GenCorp Industries, Inc.? Kung alam niyo po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: May I refer to the exact address as stated in its articles of incorporation? The

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: witness may refer to her notes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Likewise, the Chair gives continuing authority to assisting counsels from both sides to approach the witness at any point in time as well as handling lawyers to approach the witness at any point in time as they may find it necessary.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly answer the question, Attorney Suzette, once you've referred to your notes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: So the principal office of GenCorp is located in 3rd Floor, PVL Building, Rizal, Barangay 3-A, Poblacion,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Davao City, Davao del Sur, Region 11, Philippines.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you. And if you know, Atty. Suzette, given that you're holding an articles of incorporation, can you please tell us who the incorporators are of GenCorp Industries, Inc.?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The incorporators of GenCorp are Saiger Saryo, Richie Yvette Cruz, Kimberly Justine Cruz,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Dinafe Masinadyong, and Gurly De La Cruz.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you. Your Honor, for the record, considering that the witness brought an article of incorporation, an original copy thereof, we will be marking said document at the appropriate time, but the marking would be D-2-1-GenCorp., Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ordered.

turns.text: could she not have been? Yes.

turns.text: I

turns.text: Sorry for interrupting. We'll proceed, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Previously, itong Jollibee Bolton Branch operated siya ng Jollibee Foods Corporation. Can you please tell us if you know, Atty. Suzette, ano po yung current status ng korporasyon na iyon, Jollibee Foods Corporation?

turns.text: Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Honor,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

The offer of the testimony of this witness is only limited to GenCorp or Metro Chow. Now she is being asked to attest to something as regards a corporation of which I would assume she is not general counsel or in-house counsel of.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: young

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: too

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: at that time, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: She was

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: only seven years old, Your Honor. I don't think she would know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Justin, kindly respond.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Outside also, Your Honor, outside the offer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, In the offer, we stated the true interest of the Vice President. And number two, she already previously answered that she was aware, Your Honor.

turns.text: Of the corporation, Your Honor. I'm referring to the corporation. Of the previous corporation that operated and owned the branch.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, sir. Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So yung limang branches na binanggit niyo, iba-ibang korporasyon yan, iba-hiwalay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Before, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Same stockholders as GenCorp? Not necessarily?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not necessarily.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And then GenCorp bought?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Binili ba nung GenCorp yung limang korporasyon na nagmamayari ng limang Jollibee?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Were you already in-house counsel of GenCorp? As in-house counsel of GenCorp rather, were you made aware of these acquisitions of GenCorp when you took over as in-house counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: When I took over, I think there are three already or four. which were transferred.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So you did not see the transfer documents?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not see the transfer documents.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So when you said that the vice president does not own the corporation that owns the Bolton branch, you're merely basing it on the fact that If she's a few years older than you, she would have been too young and not based on any records that you have access to. Would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So that would be a fair statement. It's not based on any documents you've seen personally as the in-house counsel of GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, that previously owned. Now, are you asking her now a new corporation for a different branch or it's the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: same?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, a different branch, a different corporation. I'll just ask about the provenance of the... I will lay the basis, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly lay the basis, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Atty. Suzette, sinabi niyo po sa presiding officer that when you entered, only around four has been... transferred to GenCorp?

turns.text: It was...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

And how would she even testify to the business purpose for which this... companies were transferred to another owner and what was the judgment call that went into the transfer of these companies, of these franchises, your honor, or the shareholders in this company to another, to GenCorp. Incompetent to testify, your honor, as to the intention or the contractual intent or the business purpose for the transfer. of ownership of these franchises. To

Alam niyo po ba kung bakit in-acquire ng GenCorp yung mga prangkisang yun ng Jollibee na pag-aari ng ibang kumpanya nun, if you know only?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. To centralize the five stores, to put it into one corporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That's the intent of GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ilan doon ang alam niyong yun ang intention? Yung tatlo lang o yung lima?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Eventually, like right now, five stores.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung tatlo pala bago nun. So yung dalawa, definitely, alam mo. But to consolidate. So yung first three stores, ang intention ng GenCorp kung bakit nilagay sa ilalim ng GenCorp is to consolidate.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not yet. Well, it started in 2021.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: After Jollibee Bolton was transferred to the operations of GenCorp or after it was made under GenCorp, then the process of dissolution for JolliA has commenced.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In the following year, in 2024, the table 39 in the alleged or supposed forensic report states that the alleged total computed undeclared income from GenCorp is 74,056,000 480,000 pesos. And what is the actual amount disbursed by GenCorp Industries Inc. to the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp only disbursed 612,419 pesos and 14 centavos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.text: sir.

turns.text: Before we go on recess so that the senator judges have something to ponder on as well, Attorney Suzette, just a few. What do you mean by return on capital? Ba't siya binabalikan ng kapital? Ano po ba ang interest niya sa branch na iyon?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: no... Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

Subject?

turns.text: Now,

turns.text: kinumpirman nyo na po magkano yung natanggap ng Vice Presidente at kung ano ba talaga ang interes ng Vice Presidente sa GenCorp Industries, Inc. turns.text: She is not a stockholder of GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She has no involvement.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

Suzette, what, if any, is the beneficial ownership of the Vice President in GenCorp Industries Inc.? If at all.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She is not a beneficial owner.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now let's go to the specifics of the operations of GenCorp. Given the investment that you confirmed earlier and the fact that return of capitals were made to the Vice President, my question is, what is the participation or involvement of the Vice President, if any, in the management and decision making in GenCorp industries in general?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She has no involvement in the management of the business.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Even in Times Square branch, she has no involvement or participation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: of GenCorp Industries, given that you have confirmed that the Vice President has a loose investment, according to you, in GenCorp Industries,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: What is the involvement or participation or influence of the Vice President in respect to the finances of GenCorp Industries Inc based on your personal knowledge or documents available to you?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She is not a stockholder, she is not a manager, or she is really not part of GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, given still the investment that you confirmed before this impeachment court, how about with respect to her participation and or involvement? or influence in the management, utilization, or control of the assets and properties of GenCorp Industries, Inc. If any.

turns.text: She has no involvement.

turns.text: She has no authority, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Even in Times Square branch, she has no authority.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She has no authority, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, you earlier mentioned po na kanina na meron pong limang branches na inooperate at pinagmamayari ng GenCorp Industries Inc. sa Jollibee. Franchises, tama po ba ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, my question is, Kung alam niyo lang po, magkano po ang required capital investment and franchise fee sa mga branch na ito? Kung alam niyo po, Atty. Suzette.

turns.text: I actually have not reviewed the original franchise agreement. I only reviewed the renewal of the franchise agreement. And it's highly confidential. So, I don't... I don't want to...

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, we understand, Atty. Suzette. Now, can you please explain for everyone's understanding what this confidentiality is all about and what this liquidated damages is all about? Kasi hindi naman po lahat abogado.

turns.text: Included in the terms and conditions of the renewal of the franchise agreement is that we cannot disclose any information in the agreement, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, again, dahil impeachment ito ng Vice Presidente, at gusto lang po natin talagang malaman, how much, if any, ang capital contribution ni Vice President? or contribution niya sa franchise fee sa Jollibee Bolton Branch?

turns.text: Wala sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How about in Jollibee Matina Crossing Branch? How much is the Vice President's contribution to the franchise fee or required capital investment for the Jollibee Matina Crossing Branch?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: None.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How about in the Jollibee G-Mall that is also now operated and owned by GenCorp Industries Inc.? How much is the capital contribution in respect to the franchise fee or capital investment of the vice president, if any, in the Jollibee-Gmall branch?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: None.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How about in the Jollibee-Abriza branch? How much was the vice president's contribution to the franchise fee or capital investment of GenCorp in Jollibee-Abriza branch, if any? At kung alam niyo po, Atty. Suzette.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, sinabi niyo kanina may investment po si Vice President specific sa Jollibee Times Square branch. Yung tanong ko po, magkano kung mayroon man ang kontribusyon ng ating Vice Presidente sa franchise fee or capital investment required sa branch na yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala rin po siyang investment doon sa franchise fee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. You stated that Wala siyang investment sa franchise fee at wala siyang contribution sa capital investment pero kinunperman niyo na may loose investment si Vice President sa specific Times Square branch. How do you reconcile these two statements po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Ang franchise, the franchise is granted to the corporation sir, not to an individual. So if the

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And in this instance, what would be the interest or relationship of the vice president given her loose investment in GenCorp to that specific franchise?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Earlier, you mentioned that the vice president has no authority to represent or transact for. GenCorp Industries, Inc. Medyo iba po yung tanong ko. turns.text: Objection, Your Honor.

turns.text: What's the objection, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.text: I will reform so it will be clear.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I was about to sustain it but on the ground of being vague but kindly reform counsel.

turns.text: I am not aware of any contracts for that branch, for Times Square.

turns.text: I'm not aware if she has any influence.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, on the perspective of GenCorp. What did GenCorp ask from the vice president, if any, in relation to these contracts?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Nothing, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And how much, if any, did the vice president receive or earn in relation to the contracts entered into between the local government of Davao City and GenCorp Industries, Inc., which in particular was through its Jollibee Bolton branch, if any, and if you're aware?

turns.text: And can you please explain why the Vice President did not earn or receive any income or revenue from these contracts with the local government of Davao City?

turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. How would she know? Again, this is already stretching your allegation within personal knowledge and based on records, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.text: she does not attend the meetings and i haven't seen her uh attend any company gatherings or like in the christmas party i don't i don't see her she she is not involved really in the business

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay

turns.text: Actually, there is no Compensation Committee in the Bylaws of the Corporation, sir.

turns.text: So, these positions in the Executive Committee The Compensation Committee and other committees. Actually, these are not in the bylaws of the corporation. turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It is prepared by the accounting staff and certified by the corporate secretary.

turns.text: Now, if you know what communication or notification does Metro City Chow Foods Corporations make or its management? Vice President in relation to the preparation and filing of the general information sheets.

turns.text: No notifications, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And how is that paid up capital of 12,500 related to the needed capital investment for a Chowking branch?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I don't understand the question. I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: How is that? Paid up capital of 12,500 in the corporation by the vice president. How can that be used or how is that being used by the corporation in relation to the capital investment needed for the Chowking branch? If you know and if any.

turns.text: Well, the franchise fee is granted to the corporation so it will be the corporation who will pay the franchise fee.

So base sa sagot nyo, hindi lang po ito return of investment, return on investment na po ito, maliba na lang kung may alam pa kayo at masasabing iba pang investment ng Vice President na binabalik. Kung wala na po, then we will leave it at that. Wala na po, Atty. Suzette?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Wala kayong alam. Pero posibleng meron, hindi nyo lang alam. Would that be a fair statement?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Hindi ko nga po alam kung meron because I could not verify it from other records.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That's the answer of the witness counsel. Move on, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Whether it be in line with the questioning of the presiding officer, whether it be a return on investment or

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: a return of investment, Madam Counsel, you are following. It is still income, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes. Whether binalik yung ininvest mo, binalik yan. Income yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the indulgence of Attorney Lorna, what is the pleasure of Senator Judge Rafi?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Kanina pa ako nagtataka.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Alam naman niya kung bakit siya kinuhang witness today para sa unexplained wealth ni BP Sara, for her to explain the unexplainable. And yet, marami siya mga hindi alam. Tulad na lang nung return on investment or return of investment, she could have at least asked and made some research. Tinanong siya sa sana yung GenCorp. Ano ba talaga ito? Return of investment or return on investment? And she cannot answer that simple question from the prosecution. Sana, alam mo pupunta ka rito, Madam Witness, kumawa ka ng mga research tulad yan, return of investment ba or return on investment? Tapos ngayon, wala man lang maipakitang dokumento tulad ng kontrata o cancel check na para ipatunay na yun talaga ay return of investment. Kalimbawa na lang. Di ba alam mo yung may cancel check kung tawagin? Kasi kanina nabanggit mo, cheque ang ibinayad para dun sa return of investment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So may cancel check yun. Nakita mo ba yung cancel check?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, I did not.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: No, you should have asked a copy of that cancel check. Kasi alam mo, magkitistigo ngayon dito. You should have asked for the contract. Na ito yung return of investment, sige nasa niyong kontrata. Kung walang kontrata, nasaan yung cancel check? Kasi sa cancel check, sa cheque, nilalagay doon kung para saan yung binabayad sa kanya. Tama? So you should at least ask from GEMCOR a copy of that cancel check. Para pagpunta mo rito, readyng ready ka na. It seems to me, 15 years ka abogado, mukhang hindi ka pa ready. Or, nagmamangmangan lang po kayo. Maraming salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The remarks of the gentleman are noted. Atty. Kapunan, your witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Whether it is a return of investment which now is becoming clear that it is not because

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: yung 2 million na yan hindi ma-reconcile sa 40 something thousand lang na-invest niya, correct? It is a return of investment or a return on investment which means She invested as either creditor, nagpahiram, or shareholder siya, or ito ay bayad sa utang sa kanya kung nagpa-utang siya, or declared as dividend. Whether, regardless of the characterization, it is income, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: As an answer, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I haven't heard your answer yet.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Not yet. Kindly answer, Atty. Suzette.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I answered yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So it is income.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of Atty. Lornas, Sen. Judge Bam wishes to make... I mean, what is your pleasure, sir?

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Just to clarify lang, two quick questions only just to add to this.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Atty. Suzette, iba-iba kasi yung numero dito, no? I mean, iba-iba yung pumapasok na monthly. Ano yung computation? Para maabot natin yung perang pumapasok kay Vice President Sara, number one. Number two, are you saying in 2026 wala na siyang natanggap? Tumigil in 2025?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: With respect to 2026 wala na natanggap, the data that I requested is for 2022 to 2025.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Iba yung data that you requested. Are you confirming that she did not receive any more money from GenCorp this year?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I cannot confirm if there is.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: So, you can't confirm whether the Vice President received any money from GenCorp in 2026?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No po, I am not part of the accounting department, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Okay, sige. Second question, ano yung formula to get these figures?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Also the formula, I do not have any participation in the computation, so I do not know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino
turns.text: Pumunta ka dito with these numbers, di mo alam kung paano nakuha yung mga numero.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I requested for data extraction for 2022 to 2025.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. Your witness, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Madam Witness, regardless

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: of the amount, Madam Witness, it could be 43,000, it could be 2 million, it could be more, it could be less. It still is income, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Correct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I already answered yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And as income,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It should be declared.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And this is income which is coming from a business. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes. Yes. And of course, as a lawyer, you know that under the Constitution, the Vice President cannot receive any other income, no matter how big. or small. She cannot receive any other income or have any business interest, personal, pecuniary interest in any other corporation. It is a clear prohibition in the Constitution. You agree?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, compound, misleading, calls for a conclusion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Zed, only if you know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may answer only if you know. If you don't, then you may say so as well.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I prefer not to answer, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You prefer not to answer?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Iba yung you prefer not to answer sa you don't know, Atty. Suzette.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I don't know, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You've made your point, Atty. Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You prefer not to answer. Why? Why do you prefer not to answer when you're here? Precisely for the purpose of clarifying the situation. Is the Vice President in violation of the Constitution by not declaring income which she received from sources other than her salary? It's

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: a clear question. Why can you not answer that?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lorna, she changed her response to I don't know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You can repeat it again, Attorney Suzette.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, however, please allow me to speak.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Attorney Justice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, again, our witnesses here are entitled to rights. One of those rights is not to be badgered by questions. Only this impeachment court will resolve in the final decision it will make. Because what Attorney Capunan is asking the witnesses, isn't this a constitutional violation? But at the start of this hearing, we are all aware as lawyers, Attorney, that only the respective senator-judges can make. That final determination. We ask, Your Honor, that this is clearly already badgering the witness as Atty. Lorna Caponan, with all due respect, knows what she is doing, Your Honor. May we move on?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I also know, Your Honor, what counsel is doing. Counsel is manifesting that I am badgering. I may have a loud voice, Your Honor, but this is already my tame voice. It could be louder. In fact, this is my kind voice. When I ask the witness, Your Honor, if she knows. Because she should know. Fifteen years in the practice of law, you do not know what should not be declared and what should be declared as a public officer. You do not know that a public officer cannot receive income apart from her legitimate salary from any other business or exercise of any profession. And to answer, Your Honor, That she prefers not to answer, I think is a violation of her oath as a lawyer. And that's why I feel agitated, Your Honor. It's a violation of her oath of office that she will say, I prefer not to answer. As an officer of the court, especially a highest impeachment court, to say that, Your Honor, I think that should be... That should not be accepted as an answer, Your Honor. I am badgering, Your Honor. I have the right to badger. We have the right to badger a witness who does not want to answer a question that should be answered.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Forgive me, counsel. Even if she refused to answer, no counsel has the right to badger the witness still, although you can be frustrated or disappointed. However,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The witness already answered that she does not know after the court reminded her that she cannot refuse to answer the question. And she already changed her answer and said she does not know. You have made your point, counsel. You have spread into the records your theory. Move on to your next point, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Let us now go to Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: First of all,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: there seems to be, have you studied the corporate directors of GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And you're saying that the previous owners of, the predecessors of GenCorp, I would have shown it in a slide, but in the interest of time, the predecessor companies of GenCorp are no longer in existence. They are dissolved, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: But

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the shareholders of those companies also, based on records and you can verify, are interlocking the shareholders of the dissolved or in the process of dissolving company

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: or

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: in the process of dissolution are interlocked shareholders or directors with GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Lacks basis. May we know when? She already answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Already answered, counsel. She said some.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: There are interlocks.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly move on, Attorney Lorna. She already answered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And in this interlocks, there is a family name that appears. Correct? Very, as a dominant shareholder, the name of JTC. JTC Corporation, or the name of the person, Jaime D. Cruz. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: As in-house counsel of Mr. Jaime Cruz, do you know, if you know, if the Vice President knows this Jaime D. Cruz?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Misleading, Your Honor. There is no prior testimony. That the witness stated that she is the counsel of Jaime T. Cruz himself.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: She's the counsel of GenCorp. We

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: know there's a separate juridical.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: She answered you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Although, although, although indeed nothing has been mentioned about it, the witness indeed admitted earlier that she's the in-house counsel of other corporations. and that the incorporator of those other corporations is Jaime T. Cruz as well. So, with your indulgence, Atty. Justine, I'll allow it. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. But I only ask that Atty. Capunan, with all due respect, lay the basis.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, kindly answer, Atty. Suzette.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Jaime T. Cruz is a common shareholder in the defunct or corporations that are in the process of dissolution which used to own the Jollibee franchises bought by GenCorp later on.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And GenCorp's principal shareholder is also Jaime Cruz.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Let me verify, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It's JTC Group of Companies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: JTC Group of Companies, which stands for, I guess, Jaime T. Cruz, correct? That's a holding company.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, it's the holding company that's the biggest shareholder of GenCorp, which in turn is owned by Jaime T. Cruz, I suppose, as the acronym suggests.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, pardon. I will have to invoke this court's own ruling, dated November 5, 2026, where it excluded documents... from the offer pertaining to JTC Group of Companies and Pikimong Pikimong. What am I trying to say, Your Honor? The subject matter being discussed now has already been excluded by this honorable court, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We are not asking for additional documents, counsel. Just simply correlating this matter to GenCorp. This does not in any way pertain to the respondent's...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Liability under any of the articles, but just to complete the story in relation to GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: We submit and we understand, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So yung predecessor companies, Jaime T. Cruz sa nakalabas, GenCorp now is owned principally, biggest shareholder, JTC, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. Move on, Your Witness, Counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Madam Witness, this Jaime T. Cruz, if you know, does

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the Vice President know? Jaime T. Cruz.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I cannot speak for the Vice President, but they are both stockholders in one corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: they are both stockholders in one corporation. And what corporation is that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The Metro City Chow Foods.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So in Metro City Chow King, Jaime T. Cruz and Vice President Sara are both shareholders. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. And in Metro Chow, she owns 20%, and Jaime Cruz owns majority.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Majority. Okay. We now go to GenCorp. In GenCorp, Jaime Cruz, JT Cruz, owns shares, but for some reason, the vice president's name does not appear in the GIS as a shareholder, but it appears in her SALN. I will propose to you now a reason. And that reason is as stated in the forensic report. And I refer you to page 22.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Apologies, Your Honor. I will have to object. Because it would now seem that the Council is testifying, not asking a question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Barring the basis laid by attorney Kapunan for a question, the question is simply asking the witness to read a portion of the report.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Then I ask respectfully that she go directly to that point.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel is so directed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Which I was saying, Your Honor, if the attorney can now go to page 22 of the report. And if it's available, can we flash page 22? of the forensic report.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: There's a table.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Is that? Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Earlier you said that both the Vice President and Jaime D. Cruz have interest in Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But in GenCorp, it is only Jaime D. Cruz that has interest. And yet, in the GIS, General Information Sheet, and yet the Vice President declared. Inursal, and that she is a shareholder. I point your attention now, and if you could read for the record, what is stated here amongst the forensic findings of expert witness, Attorney Cabrera.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Would you like to read it or would you like me to read it? Ako na lang.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. May I point the court, Your Honor, to the last paragraph? In page 22, it says, it is possible, and this is Attorney Cabrera speaking, it is possible, in my professional opinion, that the reason why the GIS of GenCorp did not disclose the respondent as stockholder is to avoid a documented conflict of interest issue, i.e., the city of Davao. dealing with a corporation owned by a family member which in this case is a previous mayor and current vice president. Note that a conflict of interest blatantly violates bidding rules. In Respondent's non-disclosure of her stockholdings in the GIS of GenCorp, notwithstanding her voluntary declaration of business interest in her salient, may feign an appearance of legitimacy that enables GenCorp to participate in public bidding processes in Davao City. In fact, In the recent testimony of current Mayor Sebastian Duterte, GENCORS secured 19 government contracts with the City of Davao, with her said brother Mayor Sebastian Duterte serving as head of the procurement entity or HOPE. Finally, If I may continue, based on our review of the GIS of GenCorp, we also found that it was JTC group of companies that was indicated as GenCorp's ultimate beneficial owner. This is not compliant with SEC Memorandum Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Framework which requires disclosure. of the identity of the natural person who ultimately owns, controls, or exercises effective control over reporting entity. Okay, my point, my question to you, Madam Witness, is you confirmed earlier on direct examination that GenCorp has government contracts with the City of Davao, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And 19 government contracts, not only with the city of Davao, but with PhilHealth.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Incidentally, you are connected with PhilHealth Davao?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Until 2019 only.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Until 2019. But you

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: joined. When did you join GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So, how long were you in PhilHealth?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Five years from 2014.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So you were in PhilHealth for five years and then you went to GenCorp. Not

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: immediately.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Not immediately. You had a two-year gap but you went to GenCorp and when you were in GenCorp, although no longer in PhilHealth, GenCorp was able to get contracts for PhilHealth, correct? From PhilHealth.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes. Isn't that a conflict of interest?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Why?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Why?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There's no conflict of interest between GenCorp and PhilHealth, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But you were an employee of PhilHealth and therefore could directly or indirectly influence your friends in PhilHealth to give the contract to GenCorp. I can see you're smiling. You agree?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I do not agree. That is an assumption, ma'am. Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: What about securing 19 government contracts with the city of Davao? If the vice president Sara Duterte were to appear in the GIS of GenCorp as a shareholder, would GenCorp be able to get 19 government contracts from the city of Davao without it appearing that there is a conflict of interest because the city of Davao is headed? by her brother who also is the head of the procuring entity. Would that be the reason, Madam Witness, in your opinion? Would that be the reason why the

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: name of the Vice President is not in the GIS so that there would be no conflict?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: of interest situation between GenCorp and the City of Davao, headed by her brother mayor

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Apologies, Your Honor. Objection. It is speculative, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lorna, I will have to sustain the objection. Either reform or move on to your next point, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: We will move on, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: The concept of beneficial ownership, Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You're familiar.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can you enlighten us again? What is beneficial ownership?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Beneficial owner is a natural person, ma'am, who ultimately controls or directs the decision of a certain corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So a beneficial owner is a natural person.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Tao, hindi company.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So when, and it is here in the forensic report. When JTC group of companies was indicated by JTC as the beneficial owner of GenCorp, and that should be, you affirm that submissions to the SEC should include beneficial ownership. You confirm that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And in the case of GenCorp, GenCorp listed... Not a natural person. GenCorp listed in the GIS that there is a beneficial owner of certain percentage apart from JTC the person. JTC the company was listed as a beneficial owner of shares when you and I know that only Natural persons can be declared as beneficial owners.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I confirm the mistake in the Beneficial Ownership Declaration of the GIS of GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So there is a mistake. Thank you for that affirmation, confirmation. So there is a mistake in the submission of GenCorp declaring JTC Corp as a beneficial owner. That is a mistake.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It should be a natural person, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And who, in your opinion, is that natural person?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: For now, I do not know because I do not have the records of JTC group of companies, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But based on this forensic report, based on latest submissions, it is the company, JTC, that's beneficial owner. But you said it is a wrong submission to the SEC.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. I admit that it is a mistake.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Was there any, you being the in-house counsel, did you make any advice to the corporate secretary to correct that mistake?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: To amend, yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: To amend? You did?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not yet.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Not yet.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But the GIS is as of December, end December 2025. We are already in November. 2026. You have

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: not yet brought to you the attention of the company where you are sole lawyers, sole counsel to correct the statement on beneficial ownership. Not yet.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I have already advised them but the amendment has not yet been done.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: The

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: beneficial

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: owner, the

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: beneficial owner of, based on, based on this forensic report, The beneficial owner of those shares should

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: be reflected as Vice President Sara in the GIS. If we were to reconcile her admission in the SALN that she is shareholder, then the correction should be, agree or not agree with me,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: If she declared it, then in the SALN, then

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It should be declared also in the GIS because she said there's a mistake on beneficial ownership that she be declared in the GIS as the beneficial owner of those shares wrongly declared as belonging to JTC Corp. Do you agree?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before you answer, Atty. Suzette. Yes, Atty. Justin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: With all due respect, misleading, Your Honor, I already asked this question directly during my direct examination to the witness. Whether the Vice President has any beneficial ownership, the categorical answer was no. Second, Your Honor, the witness has repeatedly insisted that the Vice President is not a stockholder of GenCorp Industries, Inc. So, there is no only no basis, but if you insist that point, that would be misleading, Your Honor, with all due respect.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Lorna, I will have to agree with Attorney Justin. It's a big leap.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No, Your Honor, please. This is not a speculation. This is in line with her answer to an earlier question that declaring JTC Corp as the beneficial owner is wrong. It's a wrong declaration because a company cannot be a...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: A company cannot be a beneficial owner and she did say in her answer that she already told the GenCorp to rectify that mistake.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So my next question was...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But it's a big leap, counsel, to say that JTC is owned by the Vice President or that JTC should be replaced by the name of the Vice President, especially given the fact that the court precisely did not allow the subpoenas to be issued to documents pertaining to JTC because the GIS attached to the request did not contain, of JTC, did not contain the name of the Vice President. So, what the Chair is saying is that it's a big leap.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, it is.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: To say that JTC Corp. is the Vice President. In fact,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No, Your Honor, if I may.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Attorney Larner.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: If I may, yes, Your Honor, if that were my, if that was what I was thinking, it is indeed a big leap. But that's not what I meant, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It has no relation to VP owning shares in JTC. It is related to who is the beneficial owner if it is not JTC Corp. Who is the beneficial owner of that portion of shares of GenCorp. If it is not owned by JTC, you said it is wrongly. declared in the name of JTC, then if she knows, she's in-house, who then should be the beneficial owner of the shares in the GenCorp, not JTC.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
