turns.text: in-house counsel, attorney Suzette, allow me, counsel. As in-house counsel, attorney Suzette. Tama naman po na dapat ilagay sa ngayon sa pinakalatest na rules ng SEC, hindi po ba yung totoong may-ari at hindi yung kumpanya lamang?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sabi niyo po, tama naman yun, mali yung submission. So, if you know, sino po ang nagmamay-ari ng shares na nakapangalan sa JTC na principal shareholder ng GenCorp? If you will correct it. As you have advised to correct it, how would it be corrected, if you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: will be corrected by looking at the records of JTC Group of Companies, Your Honor, to see kung sino yung stockholders of record nila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So kailangan ilagay yung individual stockholders ng JTC at hindi JTC yung nakalagay doon. Yun yung correction na pinayo nyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. And not all the stockholders, pero kung sino lang po yung pasok doon sa beneficial owner.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nang GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Nang JTC Group of Companies.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nang JTC Group of Companies na nagmamayari nga ng GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Your Witness Attorney, Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your Honor, please. I need to pee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: May we have a drink?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There would have been a better way to say it, Attorney Lorna. Chair will call for a bathroom and for those who need it, a back break.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Session will resume at around 3.30.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You did not avail of the bathroom break, Attorney Suzette?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. Good for you. Attorney Lorna, your witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Just a few more questions if you allow. Let us now go to Metro Chow. And as regards Metro Chow, the defense counsel for the respondent asks if the vice president is a shareholder, correct? To the extent that vice president is in the GIS a shareholder to the extent of 20%, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. And on question of counsel for the respondent, you were asked if she was an active shareholder. And in connection with that, you were asked, does she belong to the board of directors?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, I was asked.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes. And you were also asked, did she attend any meetings of the board of directors? And you answered no.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I answered no.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. How many board of directors meetings are there in a year of GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp or Metro City?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I'm sorry, of Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I attend around two.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Around two.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You're saying that GenCorp has two board of directors meetings in a year?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp. I'm sorry,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I'm sorry. Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I attend around two.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But Metro does not only have two meetings a year, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Possible, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Because that would be a violation, as you know, of the revised corporation code, which requires companies to have at least four meetings. In other words, Madam Witness, When you said you have not seen the vice president in any of the board of directors meetings, what you're saying is you have not seen her in the two meetings per year that you attend?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. You do not know if there are other meetings of the board of directors that she is there, but which meetings you don't attend, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That's possible.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: That's possible. Now, compensation committee. She is listed as a member of the compensation committee. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And yet you said the compensation committee is not a bylaw committee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It's not in the bylaws, ma'am, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You only created compensation committee to be compliant with bank regulations.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And in connection with that, You represented to the banks that there is a compensation committee and that the vice president is a member of the compensation committee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Unfortunately so in the GIS.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So that is a misrepresentation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not a misrepresentation but it is an error.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It is an error. What is the difference between an error and a misrepresentation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It is an honest mistake, ma'am, on the accounting staff that prepared the GIS. And there is no intention to misrepresent that the Vice President is a member of the Compensation Committee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But she is listed as a member of the Compensation Committee.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Correct. Now, meetings of shareholders. How many meetings per year does Metro have?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As to the exact number of meetings?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Annual meetings, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: You're talking year to year to year. I'm sorry,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I'm confused. In a year, how many shareholders' meetings would Metro have?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: In a year, I do not know the exact number of meetings.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And how many meetings have you attended?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As I stated earlier, ma'am, two meetings. Around two meetings per

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Shareholders,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: we're not... Not board meetings,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: shareholders' meetings. I do not attend shareholders' meetings, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You do not attend shareholders' meetings, just board meetings.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So you do not know if the vice president attends shareholders' meetings because you don't attend shareholders' meetings, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: As regards compensation from the board, do you know if the vice president as director of Metro receives compensation per dime or any other emolument from Metro.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Based on the general information sheet, ma'am, there are no compensation to any director. To any of the directors.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Do you know

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: a certain Chinese Gen B Corp owned by Jaime Cruz?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Come again, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Do you know any company called Chinese Gen B Corp owned by Jaime Cruz? Chinese Gen B Corp. Owned by Jaime Cruz and Bastet Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It's not in my records now but it's familiar.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Do you know that, are you in-house for this company? Chinese Gen B Corp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You're not in-house?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Do you know that it is owned by Jaime Cruz together with Mayor Bastet? If you know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, I cannot confirm.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, before this line of questioning continues, with all due respect, of course, to Attorney, apart from the Duterte family name, may we inquire the relevance of this? Line of questioning. Because siblings don't share incomes and you're not required to declare the...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Chair will not rule anymore if you will move on.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I am moving on, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Move on, Attorney Lorna.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Now, in

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the forensic report of Attorney Cabrera, and since you were tasked by virtue of subpoena to bring the financial statements of the two companies, Metro... Chao, and GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Did you note from both audited financial statements through the years that the opinion of the auditors are qualified opinions? Did you note that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I have

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: seen, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: You have seen that the auditors themselves Incidentally, for the record, who are the auditors of these companies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: For Metro City, Chow Foods Corporation, 2025, the auditor or the auditors are Elises and Ciudadano. And the independent auditor's report was signed by Juan Rivaldo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Both companies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: is the same for GenCorp, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. Again, can you repeat? The name is?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Juan C. Frivaldo

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Do you know these auditors?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Didn't you earlier say that one of your tasks as in-house counsel is to coordinate with the corporate secretary and the auditors of the companies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Objection. Misleading. No testimony was made to that effect, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I will reform.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly reform, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In your capacity as in-house counsel, do you have any participation as regards the preparation of the audited financial statements?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I have no participation, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay. So, you are not aware, or you could be aware, but you said that you saw, that the opinion of the auditors both with Metro and GenCorp are qualified opinions.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It is stated here, ma'am, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Being

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: an auditor, what do you mean by a qualified opinion?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Misleading, Your Honor. There was no prior testimony wherein the witness stated that she is an auditor. She

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: is an accountant.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: That

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: is the testimony. We confirm.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: As an accountant,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: would you know what the meaning of a qualified...

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Opinion from an auditor is?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Apologies, Your Honor. It's been a long time since I graduated from accountancy. But what I can remember is the perfect opinion is the unqualified opinion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So the perfect opinion is an unqualified opinion. I'm just repeating your words, Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Are you still with us, Madam Witness?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So this is not a perfect opinion of the auditors on both companies when they say it is qualified. It is a qualified opinion. So there could be, what makes it not a perfect opinion?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: As an accountant, yeah.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Based on the independent auditor's report, it is with respect to

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: the cash account.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: To the cash accounts.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And reading from... What you brought here. What in the cash accounts makes it a qualified opinion by the auditors?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Can you repeat the question, please?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I asked you earlier, what would an auditor mean by giving a qualified approval to a company? And you did say that it has reading from that report, you did say that it has to do with cash accounts, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And what in relation to the cash accounts of Metro Chow makes it a qualified opinion?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: From the auditor's report, it says that it is due to certain limitations imposed by the management.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: And what are those limitations?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I do not know, ma'am, because I am not the auditor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But as in-house, you're not part of management.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am not part of the preparation of the financial statements.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: But are

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: you part of management?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No. So you would not know anything about the cash accounts of

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: The same with Metro, the same with GenCorp. A qualified opinion is based on what? Please read.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: For Metro City Chow, The independent auditor's report states that they were not able to verify the cash account and observe physical counting of inventories.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So, on both instances,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: the opinion of the auditor is qualified.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In your own words, it is not perfect.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No further questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Redirect, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. But before we proceed to redirect, Your Honor, earlier, during the cross-examination of the counsel for prosecution, she, counsel claims that there are six franchises for GenCorp Industries Inc. when asking the witness. Now, of course, as a response to that question propounded to our witness, we had to conduct a due diligence of the court records and the forensic report. And really, Your Honor, a perusal, a judicious perusal of the court records will reveal that on the body of evidence available, there's really just five, Your Honor. So we had to go out of the court records and search where counsel may have gotten this alleged sixth franchise. And it appears, Your Honor, that upon a, to borrow the words of their witness, an open source investigation, that there is this post by one Jesus Falcis on October 8, which states that, and I quote, "Nahanap ko na ang Jollibee sa Quezon City ni Sara Duterte, este, GenCorp Inc. Nasa Cubao nga sa J&F Divino Arcade. Buti na lang, hindi naman ako talaga nagagawi doon." My question is, is this the basis of the prosecution when they asked our witness about six franchises? Because I am... Baffled. There is no six franchises in our records. And even in their forensic report, I kept on flipping. There's only five. So may I just ask the counsel what their basis is in their question when they asked our witness that there are six franchises for GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Clarification only, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would you care to respond?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Listen to my question, Attorney Lerner. Would you care to respond?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. If you want to.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: With feelings, Your Honor. With feelings. Counsel, you said due diligence, but you were not diligent enough because we have BIR witnesses here. We have a BIR witness who in fact presented a BIR document I'm holding. A BIR document marked as prosecution evidence which shows a sixth franchise. And I will read.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Can I ask this guy to read for me because it's very tiny.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Honor, Attorney Erwin was the one who presented this document.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We'll allow

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: it, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It's

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: too tiny for

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: me to

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: read.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: It's okay, Your Honor. That's precisely why the defense is interested.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It's only reading it anyway. Because

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: earlier she stated based on the forensic report.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, clearly that's not in the forensic report. Kindly, yes, counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So just clarify your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Allow us to use your pair of eyes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Erwin G. Matib
turns.text: Yes, your honor. For the record, we have with us Annex D. of the letter dated October 6, 2026 from the Bureau of Internal Revenue and it states here that one of the branches of GenCorp Industries Inc. has the tax identification number or branch code number 777-616-088-0005. The trade name is GenCorp Industries Inc. It was registered On November 28, 2024, with address 961 J&F Divino Building, Aurora Boulevard, Quirino 3A, 1102 Quezon City, NCR, 2nd District, Philippines. The nature of business is restaurants and mobile food service activities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. In that case, Your Honor, then we'll have to clarify because it's a tax code, branch code, not a franchise which was raised, not a separate franchise which was purported in the question earlier. Because tax code lang po, branch code. That's why we wanted to confirm where that is coming from. And I hope this court understands because those are allegations. That we deserve to meet as the defense counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: So it's

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: not a six franchise, but there is a branch tax code, a branch code.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No,

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: there is a six franchise. May we ask attorney Erwin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: Pakita mo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: In any venture only.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsels, please. It's nearly 4 p.m. This will not affect one way or the other. Although I appreciate that you want to argue this point longer. But whether GenCorp owns 5 or 6 or 7 or 8 franchises actually for that matter will not affect or change any of the allegations against the Vice President in regard to Article 2. It may...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Impinge upon the knowledge of the witness in regard to GenCorp's business within and or outside Davao, but be that as it may, let it be subject to the appreciation of the Senator, judges, and subject to redirect as well. Attorney Justin, if you want to pursue that point further.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And subject to recross too, if Attorney Justin will take it up in his redirect. So, can we move on, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Thank you, Your Honor. I hope the court understands. I just wanted to clarify the record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: But we will proceed now, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Proceed to your redirect.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Konting redirect lang po. Earlier, tinanong po kayo kung pinoint out niyo na po ba sa GenCorp yung fact that the VP appears to have declared herself as a stockholder of the company in her SALN. And my question actually is what personal knowledge do you have on the VP's presentation or preparation of her own SALNs?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I have no personal knowledge, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And what personal knowledge do you have on the exact dates of the SALNs that she filed as a vice president?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I also have no personal knowledge.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: No further questions, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Recross, Attorney Lorna?

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: No recross, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Let's proceed with interjections of Senator Judges. Senator Judge Erwin Tulfo is recognized. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Madam Witness, so, pakipaliwanag nga po, yung share po ni VP Sara sa Davao Bounty, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Na carryover sa Great Jolly Times, tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It is not the share, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: What

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: is it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: BP Sara has no share or stock holdings in Great Jolly Times. So whatever BP Sara invested or spent for Davao Bounty, yun po ang na-carry over when the Jollibee Times Square started its operations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Kaya

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: nga po, hanggang sa Times Square, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Alright, then Times Square to GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So, despite all this, hindi po niyo pa rin siya ma-consider na shareholder siya o stockholder kasi wala po siya sa GIF?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, she cannot be considered as a stockholder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Up to this point, ma'am, kahit na sinabi niyo na

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: sa kanyang SALN na siya po ay stockholder ng GenCorp or may share siya sa GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She has to subscribe to the stocks of GenCorp before we can consider her as a stockholder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Ma'am, tanong ko po. Pero sabi niyo kanina meron po siyang investment sa specific branch doon nga po sa Jollibee Times Square Plaza. Tama po ba ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: And Jollibee Times Square Plaza is under GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Correct. Alright. So therefore, ma'am, Then can you tell me, ano pong difference ng investment in a specific branch and investment in the corporation? Eh Jollibee Times Square is under GenCorp. Ano pong pinakaiba noon? Nag-invest ako sa Jollibee dito, tapos hindi pa siya investor or wala siyang share sa GenCorp as a whole? I do not get it. Investor lang siya dito sa Jollibee, pero itong ininvestan niya sa Jollibee, ando sa GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I think, Your Honor, you can also be an investor without being a stockholder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Ah, okay. Alright. Alright, number two, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Is it return of capital or return on capital? Because there's a difference between the two.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Return of capital.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Return of capital. Kung return of capital, ma'am, bakit every year? I mean from 2022, simula po siya naging VP, hanggang last year meron pong return of capital na umabot po sa 2.1 something million, Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As to bakit every year, I cannot answer po because I am not part of the accounting department. But for purposes of these proceedings, I requested for the data extraction from 2022 to 2025.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: All right. Mr. Presiding Officer, can you give me a few more? Well, I have two more questions for those witnesses.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: can

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: wind up, Senator

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Judge Raffi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: All right. Sir, ma'am, parang coincidence ano, nung maging VP si VP Sara, biglang lumubo ang sales ng GenCorp to 300 million. Pero nung 2021, nag-list lang ito ng 28 million. Anong milagro o produkto po ang bininta nila? Na biglang lumobo sila. Na from 2022 hanggang 2024, umabot sa 1 billion ang sales nila. Pero bago siya naging VP, ang sales lamang po nila ay nasa few million lang po. At ang capital ay 1.25. Nung 2022 po, medyo 28 million lang po. 2021, 28 million lang po yung kanilang sales. Bakit bigla lumobo na po? From 2022, VP na siya hanggang wala po kayang conflict of interest noon, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: If you can recall, GenCorp has five branches. And the acquisition of these branches is gradual. Hindi siya one time. So from 2021, may na-acquire na isa. 2022, may nadagdag until 2024. So considering na, Tumataas ang number ng, nadadagdagan ang number ng Jollibee stores, it follows na tumataas yung income, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: How can, papano po siya? Last question, Mr. President and Officer. Papano kung tumataas? Pero sabi niyo noong 2023, 2.7 million lang. At 2024, 3.3 million lang ang net income ng company. Pero listed sales niyo po is 1 billion during this past 4 years or 2 years?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: With respect to that, I cannot give an answer on the income because I am not part of the operations din po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Oh, okay. Well, that's all for me, Presiding Officer. Thank you, Madam Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Erwin. Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo is recognized. If you're ready, sir, you may proceed. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So, Madam Witness, klaro tayo ngayon, return of, not on, capital.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Return of capital.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Kasi kanina, When asked to explain this return of capital, ang sagot niyo, I cannot verify the amounts because there are no written records for this investment, correct? You said that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Pero alam niyo naman, natatanongin namin ito sa iyo, yung mga ebidensya na meron ka para mapatunay doon sa sinasabi mong return of capital, yung binahit sa kanya, 2.1 million.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So anong patunay ka meron na talagang return of capital yun at hindi yung dividendo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There are no dividends declared and she is not entitled to dividends because she is not a stockholder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: That is correct. On the other hand, explain to us bakit mo nasabi return of capital yun? At siyempre kung return of capital yun dapat may input. Meron siyang inilagay na pera doon sa kumpanya na para maibalik sa kanya yung capital niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: You are correct, Your Honor. May nailagay nga po siyang pera sa Davao Bounty, which did not push through.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Ang Articles of Incorporation, 46,000. I do not know if there are other investments kasi yung 46,000 is the creation of a corporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Correct. At hindi na tuloy. So from 46,000, nakatanggap siya ng 2.1 million pabalik

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: sa kapitan niyo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So paano nangyari yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Paano nangyari na?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: From 46,000, ininvest niya doon sa Davao Bounty at ibinalik sa kanya sa return of capital niya, 2.1 million. Paano nangyari yun? Do the math. Do the math.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The 46,000 is the creation of the corporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: So, I do not know if there were other investments made na hindi nakareflect sa articles of incorporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: At alam mo, pag-uusapan natin yan ngayon, bakit hindi ka mag-gumawa ng research? 15 years ka abogado at accountant ka pa at that. So you should have at least done some research and then at the same time did some asking. Why didn't you do that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yun nga po ang ginawa ko and I did not find any verifiable document. So I cannot produce paper out of thin air. So apologies if I cannot give a figure.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Then you're

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: not a credible witness in that way, in this case. Kasi wala kang nasasabi sa amin eh. Puro I do not know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I leave that to the judgment of the Honorable Senator-Judges, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Yes, for me. Because it's very simple.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Just do the math. Sinabi kanina, 46,000, nag-invest siya doon sa Davao Bounty na hindi natuloy na maging franchise pag-aari ng Gian Court later on. Ibinabalik sa kanya. Ay 41 million as a return of her investment. Hindi mo ma-explain. Nasaan yung mga kontrata? Nasaan yung mga cancelled checks? Do you have a copy of the cancelled checks?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As stated earlier, I do not have a copy of the cancelled checks.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Alam mo na maging testigo ka dito tungkol dito sa paksang ito. Hindi ka man lang humingi ng kopya ng mga dokumento tulad ng cancelled checks, tulad nitong contracts, etc.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: If I may, Your Honor, I believe

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Witnesses from the bank would also be presented so the body can verify if the amounts that I submitted to this honorable court matches with the bank records.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: No, kasi yung canceled checks, ibinabalik doon sa nag-issue, which happens to be GenCorp, diba? Nag-issue lang tseke kay VP Sara.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: You are correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Then, why didn't you ask GenCorp? Copy of the canceled check. Eh total, ikaw in-house counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not anymore ask for the copy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Why not?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Alam mo naman,

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: matitisigo ka tungkol

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: dito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The fastest way that I can provide the information that these honorable senator judges might need is through data extraction.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Madam witness, meron akong mga researcher dyan na nag-aaral sa law school, second year college. Para sa akin, this is my own opinion. Mas magaling pa mag-research sa iyo or nagmaang-maangan ka lang. I'm sorry ha kasi ilang araw na nag-present ng testigo tong defense na parang nalilito kami eh. It's either may tinatago or ayaw sabihin kung ano talaga yung totoo or kulang kayo sa kaalaman. I don't know which is which. But really, you know na mag-tetestigo ka tungkol sa GenCorp. And you should have came here prepared. E pumunta ka rito, maraming mga butas sa iyo na hindi mo masagot-sagot, mga simpleng katanungan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Tulad nitong, last na lamang po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, you may wind up, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: When

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: you say there are no written records, did you mean wala talaga? Tama? Wala?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So, nakadrawing lang sa hangin lahat ng transaksyon ng Jollibee Times Square, kung gano'n?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Not Jollibee Times Square, Your Honor. No written records with respect to Davao Bounty.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: No written records. So, ibig sabihin, wala kang ginawa talagang pag-hahalughog or pag-reresearch o pag-tatatanong. Dahil babalik ko sa sinabi kanina, alam niyo po na kayo magtitisigot tungkol sa Gen Corp.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Unexplainable wealth ang pinag-uusapan natin dito. And you're here to explain to us how did it happen and how it happened. And nalilito ka eh. Pati kami nalilito na rin sa mga nakakalito mong kasagutan. Lastly, very simple. Hindi mo mai-account sa amin yung 2.1 million na ibinalay ka sa return of capital from 46,000 na in-invest niya sa Davao Bounty. At yung explanation mo very flimsy at kahit na siguro elementary, mahirapan ma-connect eh. Kasi you have to have documents. Diba? You have to have contracts para mapatunayan na yung 46,000 ay naging 2.1 million, papaano?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Doon pala nga sa 46,000, do you have a document tungkol sa 46,000 na?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, the Articles of Incorporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: You have that, right. Okay. Doon sa contract na para naging 2.1 million yung 46,000, do you have a document?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am not aware if any such contract exists. I did not see anyone.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Exactly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Precisely. Correct. Then you should have at least inquired. Being the house counsel, being the in-house counsel, you should have asked your colleagues o kung sino ba mga opisyal doon sa gem court, nasaan na ang kontrata para dito kasi iniimbitahan ako maging witness. Come on.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: did. And then what did they do?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: And then?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There are no contracts.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So walang kontrata.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not see any contract.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So ibig sabihin, yung usapang hangin lang ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Or

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: under the table.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I will not speculate on that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: No, kasi sabi mo walang kontrata eh. When in fact, we're talking about serious business to ah. Hindi naman ito yung mga sari-sari store. Malaking kumpanya ito, korporasyon ito. You ask and then they said there is no contract. Then you should ask them, bakit walang contract? Kasi kung ako, I will push on. Okay, there's no contract being in-house counsel. Teka muna, bakit wala pong contract? Eh, tatanungin sa akin pagdating ko sa impeachment court, they will ask me that. What would I tell them?

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Dito kayo naipit. And you're a lawyer for 15 years, you said.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Like I said, mga researcher dito sa Senate, siguro, mas kina nag-aaral pa sa law school, baka pinagtatawan ka. That's just my opinion. Thank you. Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Pangilinan is recognized. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Magandang hapon, Attorney.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. I will just follow up on the questions raised earlier by Senator Rafi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, kasi nung ikaw ay nasa direct examination, maliwanag sa'yo. Walang participation whatsoever si Vice President Sara Duterte sa GenCorp management. Walang participation whatsoever. Zero participation. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. No stock holdings. She has no position. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: you said no participation whatsoever. So, and then, when we started... When the presiding officer, and I think again in direct examination, you mentioned that she actually had a loose investment. She was a loose investor. Tama?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There is a loose investment, Your Honor, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. So, and she was receiving benefits from that loose investment?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There were disbursements, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, okay. So, zero? No participation whatsoever? Or? Merong konting participation dun sa kaunti mong nalalamang participation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As far as I am aware, Your Honor, she has no participation in the management and in the operations of the business.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: You were also asked about no role whatsoever. But receiving benefits, you are a recipient. Then you have a role. Ikaw ay tumatanggap ng benepisyo. Beneficiary ka nung So, it's not correct to say that there is no participation or no role whatsoever. You participated as a beneficiary. Are you saying, therefore, that it's not exactly accurate that she had no role whatsoever?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The way I understand the word participate in business is

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: a beneficiary is somebody who benefits from monies. Isn't that being a participant?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: One who benefits from money is a recipient, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Exactly. So it's incorrect. Let's be clear here. You said you were so categorical, you were so clear, na no participation whatsoever. And now it's turning out, meron pala. Tama. Meron as a recipient.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: As a recipient,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Now, my next question is, nung tinanong ka about being a recipient, at tinanong ka ng presiding officer, ano ba itong arrangement na ito? Sabi mo, it's a loose agreement, loose investment. You were the one who used the term. And then, tinanong ka ni Senator Bam, you're familiar with what was received in 2022, 2023, 2024, tama? But you're not familiar with 2026.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Why not?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not ask for the 2026 if there was any.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Why not?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Because the subpoena is 2022 to 2025.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, but if these questions were raised, you would have been able to explore further what exactly is going on. I raised that question because is it possible that there are other...

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It is possible.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And you don't know that. So, di ba? Kasi limang kumpanya yun eh. So, posible bang merong ibang... Binibigyan ang accounting na hindi mo alam dahil hindi mo natanong.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: May I clarify on the limang kumpanya, your honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Well, okay, go ahead, please. Branches, the branches.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Limang

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: branches, your honor, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, in other words, these other five branches can be providing additional compensation, income, loose return on investment, but you wouldn't know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The data extracted from 2022 to 2025 is everything that GenCorp has disbursed and it all came from Times Square branch only.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But there are four branches.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is why the data extracted is for the whole GenCorp. So meaning the whole five branches and yung lumabas na data na sinubmit ko dito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Galing

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: lang lahat sa Times Square branch.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: I'll go through my second round. Forgive me, Attorney, but earlier you were so clear and categorical that there was no participation whatsoever. And now, meron pala as a loose investor. Kasi loose investment. So investor siya. Loose lang nga. So medyo, I'd like to know, what else don't you know? Or what else are you

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Not really categorical about. I'm just raising these questions. I have no answer. I'm just raising these questions at this time.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Kiko. Senator Judge Sotto is recognized. The former Senate President. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Mr. Presiding Officer, thank you, kind sir. Atty. Punay, you know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Good afternoon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Good afternoon, witness. Yes, good afternoon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: You are familiar, of course, with corporation law.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Yeah, okay. Before that, what does GenCorp stand for? Ano yung G-E-N?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Nothing, Your Honor. It's just GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Doesn't stand for anything?

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: So yung GEN, wala?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala. If

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: there is, if it's an abbreviation, it should appear on the Articles of Incorporation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: But it's not. So there's no meaning to it. It's just...

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: As

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: said, corporation law. What are the functions of a corporate secretary?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: To do the minutes of meetings, send notifications to the stockholders, keep corporate records, and a lot more, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Who's the corporate secretary of GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Ms. Girlie De La Cruz.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Girlie Dela Cruz. Who is the corporate secretary of Metro Chow?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: The same, Girlie Dela Cruz.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Same.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: As far as I know, and addressing the defense, it is the corporate secretary who records the attendance of board members and as well as their compensation. I was wondering why these details are being testified by an in-house counsel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Bakit? Why did they choose you instead of the Corporate Secretary of GenCorp to testify?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I cannot answer why they chose me.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Perhaps, Counsel Justin may be able to answer that. We're curious. Senator Sobiria and I are curious why. Why not the Corporate Secretary? She would be in a better perspective of all these questions being asked.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: po. Senator. And we do understand the concerns of the Senator judges. The defense only wishes if we could give one one-stop shop witness on these matters but unfortunately we can't. The reason why we presented Atty. Puna is because we determined her to be the best person from the persons from GenCorp, Your Honor. To be candid, Your Honor. To be direct.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: She has the most knowledge on these matters, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Better than thee. Corporate Secretary.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: That is our assessment,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: To be candid, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Okay. That is your assessment. We will accept that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Just one final question, Madam Witness. Would you agree or disagree with the statement of Atty. Cabrera that both corporations have interlocking directors?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I agree, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: You agree? Correct. And you know, of course, that they have the same in-house counsel like you?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Same person filing in SEC?

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Same corporate secretary?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Yes, same corporate secretary, same company email address, same company telephone and mobile numbers, same contact persons, same independent auditors, and same chief financial officer. And your answer is?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes. Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: You agree with him?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I agree, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: All right. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you, Senator Judge Sotto. Senator Ontiveros is recognized. You may proceed, ma'am. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer. Ayong hapon, Atty. Suzette.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: May hapon, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Hindi ko na uusisain kung saan nyo nakuha, paano nyo binoo yung term na loose investment. Pero parang malinaw, that term only means na may ininvest si VP Sara Duterte. May ininvest siya na pera sa isang business na carryover sa GenCorp. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay, salamat. So, yung loose investment, nag-start po nung pang 2007. Pero noong 2022,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kumita si VP Duterte nung total 2.14 million pesos dun sa tinawag niyong return of capital. Return of capital. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, kumita nga siya. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes. Okay po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, eto nga po eh, tumingin po ako sa records ng natanggap na pera ni VP Duterte mula sa Times Square. For four years, may monthly siya na natatanggap na pera. Parang kita o profits yan. So, hindi lang soli ng kapital.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: nanote ko rin po, Atty. Suzette, na wala pong dividend declaration ang GenCorp. Mula nung kanyang incorporation, niminsan wala.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: kung may natanggap si VP Duterte na returns o kung ano pa man ang tawag sa binibigay sa kanya na monthly, para pong lumalabas pa nga na preferred shareholder po siya. Preferred shareholder. Sa isang korporasyon na may mga undocumented, may mga informal na transaksyon. Dahil sabi nyo nga kanina, may mga maaaring nangyayari na hindi nyo nalalaman. So, parang

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: preferred

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: shareholder po. Anyway, to continue.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: ibig pong sabihin mula 2007 kung saan ipinasok yung loose investment. Hanggang 2024, kung kailan nagsimula yung buwanan na pag-disburse sa kaniya, may financial interest siya sa isang business. Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes. Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: ang interest na yun ay yung business na na-carry over sa GenCorp. Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes po. So, kahit... Indirect lang po or loose yung investment or business interest. Winding up on this question, Mr. Presiding Officer, whether sa GenCorp yan o sa old company, as a lawyer, Atty. Suzette, bawal po yan sa Constitution, di po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: am not sure, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Even I who am not a lawyer, I'm sure. Malinaw yung nakalagay po doon sa ating konstitusyon. The Vice President quote, shall not during said tenure directly or indirectly participate in any business. Tama po ba ako? I'm asking you again as a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: that's from the Constitution, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, it is from the Constitution.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Last two questions on this topic, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may wind up, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Wind up on this topic. Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Personal po ba kayong magkakilala, Atty. Suzette, ni Vice President Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kasi ilang beses po kanina ang tawag niyo sa kanya ay Sara.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Sara.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: But

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I do not know her personally.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: don't know her personally. And lastly po sa paksang ito,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Well, alam niyo po ba na si VP Sara Duterte mismo ang nagdeklara sa kanyang SALEN na siya ay may business interest sa GenCorp Industries mula 2024 hanggang 2025?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, from what I have learned from this impeachment proceedings siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: so you have learned this from the impeachment proceedings or elsewhere. Pero ang sumatotal po ay kahit pa subukan ninyo, with all due respect, Sabihin na wala o merong business interest si VP Duterte sa GenCorp, she made an admission already for the record para sa ating kabatidang lahat. So initially, salamat kayo as Attorney Suzette. Salamat po Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Riza, Senator Judge Villanueva. Attorney Lorna, you may sit down.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: It's very matigas.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Very what? Then you can unseat one of the lawyers seated beside you so that you can have a softer seat.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lorna Patajo-Kapunan
turns.text: I'm sorry, Your Honor, it's also matigas.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I cannot do anything about that anymore, Attorney Lorna. Senator Judge Villanueva, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you, Mr. President. Good afternoon,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Binanggit niyo ho kanina na ilang beses kayong umaten dun sa board meetings ng, if I'm not mistaken, Metro City Chow. Nakakita niyo po ba o napansin si VP Sara?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Wala po siya when I attended the board meetings.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Dalawang beses lang po kayong umaten?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Both Metro Chow and GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I cannot remember for GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: And ano yung ginawa niyo po nung umaten doon kayo? Observer lang or?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No. You

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: take notes?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I actually advise the board for some important things.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Like?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
