turns.text: Before,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So you're familiar with the filing. And you also said that she was not, and is not.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: A shareholder of record. Tama.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: For GenCorp, yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, so nabanggit nga.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, in other words, because she's not a shareholder of record, but she claims she is, hindi ba ano yun? False information or inaccurate information at the very least?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It depends on her intention, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, yes. In other

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: words, it could be inaccurate or it could be false. Inaccurate at the very least, false, you know, could also be false. A false filing or an inaccurate filing, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: You're familiar with the SALN, no?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But if it's a

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: false filing, then that's false testimony.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: therefore, perjury.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: You're right. Is that right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: If it was intentionally and deliberately done, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, okay. Just for the record. Now, with respect to, is it possible that the reason why she placed it in her SALN is because precisely she's been receiving this return in investments? Would that be possible? In the realm of the possible?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Possible.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Except that, It should have been reflected in her SALN and also on 2022 and 2023. Because based on your record or your information, the return on investments were given or return on capital were received 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So medyo may gap pa doon. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, on the matter of going back to the loose investment, when did you find out about the loose investments being turned over to the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: When I conducted the study on the history of the corporations.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, a long time ago?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No. When the impeachment... Impeachment time na.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So about July?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Probably, probably July.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, so in other words, you had enough time to ask for the documents, supporting documents, etc. But again, from July up until today, you were unable to secure the documentation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I requested for the data extraction last week.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes. How did you find out through the documents?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Nakita lang ninyo na may tinatanggap pala siya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I requested po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: You requested accounting?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, and then they gave it to you?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But no supporting documents, just a list of the monies received?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay, so that's where the trouble is. And I hope you understand. You have no supporting documents. For now. For now. That's why we're requesting it. And that's why it's difficult just for the figures being presented to us. We believe we need supporting documents to be able to better understand this matter of return of capital. So we'd like to thank Senator

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Erwin for requesting that so that we can better understand. Kasi mahirap naman na we will just take your word for it without the necessary supporting documents. I hope you understand.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And one last, just to yung sa external auditor, you saw the qualified opinion, you said that, you read it. I

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: read it, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Could you, so sinabi doon, We are not able to verify the cash account and observe physical counting of inventories due to certain limitations imposed by the management. What are these limitations imposed by management? Would you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Did you ask?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Why not?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not ask.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Why not? Because you're supposed to provide them legal advice on legal inquiries.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: You don't want to have a qualified opinion from your external auditors if you're a company serious about your operations, right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, is it not your duty to at least inquire as to why, what were the limitations, and provide the right advice as a lawyer, as their in-house general counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I did not.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. So, and you said earlier that you were supposed to, you know, your role is to address legal inquiries, etc. But in this case, you did not do that. And one last question. Sabi mo kanina na you're not aware whether the employees were contractual or regular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: not aware kung ilan po yung regular or contractual.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So, ilan ang empleyado? Hindi lang dalawa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Hindi ko rin po alam kung ano yung exact number ng empleyado namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: And your role is also on employee discipline as counsel, right?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So you're not, you don't know how many employees there are? You don't know whether they are contractual or regular?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I do not know the exact numbers po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: But you're in charge of employee discipline?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am in charge of employee discipline in the manner that I do investigations kung may mga, for example, may pilferage. Ganun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. No further questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Riza. You may proceed, ma'am. You have two minutes when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Attorney Suzette, sabi niyo kanina, direktor pa rin si VP Duterte ng Metro City Chow Corporation noong 2022 hanggang 2025. Nung 2022, nung naging VP na siya, nag-attempt ba siyang mag-recuse or umalis bilang corporate director?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am not aware if there is such an attempt.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pero sumototal, hindi siya umalis, andun pa rin siya hanggang 2025 at least. Stockholder

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: pa rin po siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yung pagiging corporate director. Corporate director pa rin siya. Yes. Hanggang last year at least. Okay po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And then, tungkol naman sa mga kontrata sa Davao LGU.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alam po ba ninyo na si VP Duterte ay naging business partner ni Jaime T. Cruz sa mga kumpanyang pinag-uusapan natin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: They are both stockholders in Metro City Chow.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, so may business relationship sila as stockholders. Specifically sa Metro City Chow Foods nga po, alimbawa, si VP Sara ay may 20% ng shares, habang si Jaime T. Cruz ay may halos 80%. Yun naman pong kapatid ni VP na si Mayor Sebastian Duterte, sa Grand King's Food at Grand MD Business Development, mayroon siyang tig 5% ng shares ng dalawang kumpanyang iyon. Sa SPMC Chow Foods, 15%. At sa Times Square Chow Foods, 20%. At may shares din siya sa Chinese Gen B Food Corporation. Aware po ba kayo dito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I'm not aware of the stock holdings of Baste and all those other corporations that you have mentioned, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Pero aware kayo na mayroon siyang stock holdings doon kahit di niyo alam yung percentages?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: From your statement.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: From my statement. Hindi niyo po alam ito bago ko itinanong sa inyong ngayong hapon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, Your Honor. I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kino-confirm niyo po ba na ang GenCorp ay inawardan ng labing siyam na kontrata ng administrasyon ni Mayor Sebastian Duterte, ang kapatid ni VP Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Itong parehong GenCorp na may declared interest, winding up with one last question, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po. Yung same-GenCorp na may declared interest ang vicepresidente na kapatid ni Mayor Duterte at yung same-GenCorp na may controlling interest yung JTC group of companies na yung may-ari ay si Jaime T. Cruz na documented close business associate ni Mayor Duterte, ni Mayor Sebastian Duterte.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, huling tanong po para sa akin ngayong hapon para sa inyo. Bilang corporate counsel, kung may posibleng conflict of interest sa pagitan ng inyong kumpanya at isang government official na may personal interest or family business connections sa inyong shareholders,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Tungkulin po ba ninyong i-flag ito sa management ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. So, at hindi po ba na tungkulin nyo nga ito para masiguro na sumusunod ang inyong kumpanya sa batas, masiguro na maiwasan yung mga questionable transaction, masiguro na maprotektahan ang kumpanya laban sa posibleng legal liability?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kasi nga, kung magkakasuhan man, kayo din po ang sasagot, kayo din po ang haharap po, di po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: There's a possibility.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: There's a possibility.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, muli, Atty. Suzette, dagang salamat. Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Senator Judge Riza. Just a few questions, Mr. Presiding Officer, Atty. Suzette, bear with us. I assure you, we will let you go before 6 and we will be adjourned before 6. Unang tanong po, saan po ang main office address ng GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp is 3rd floor, PVL building, Bolton, Corner, Rizal Street. Bolton Street.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So may Jollibee branch din po sa parehong building kung saan may opisina ang GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, dun sa bidding documents ng GenCorp, yung sinasabi ni Senate President kaninang 19 contracts. na nakalagay GenCorp Bolton. Ang ibig sabihin po nun, GenCorp na may address sa Bolton at hindi automatic ang nangangahulugang Jollibee Bolton yung nanalo sa bidding.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kanina

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: po kasi nabanggit niyo nung tinatanong kayo ng Atty. Justin na yung mga kontrata ay galing sa apat na branches maliban sa Times Square. Pero nung pinasuri ko po kasi yung mga bidding documents, hindi naman po nakalagay yung particular na Jollibee branch na binigyan ng award. So ano po ang basihan ninyo doon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Ang binibigyan po ng award is the corporation kasi siya po yung may...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Exactly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tinanong po kayo kanina kung meron po ba na nakuha ang kontrata ang Jollibee sa Times Square. Kung tama pagkakaalala ko, sabi niyo po wala. Pero ang nananalo po sa bidding, GenCorp. Hindi naman po yung Jollibee branch na pag-aari ng GenCorp. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi naman po nagbibid yung branch ng Jollibee na pag-aari ng GenCorp. Ang nagbibid po ay GenCorp. Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: GenCorp ang nagbibid.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kung sino man po magsusupply dun sa limang branch, eh problema na po ng GenCorp. Yan yung nanalong bidder.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would that be correct? Okay. Next point, Atty. Suzette. Ano po ang relasyon ni Jaime kay Richie? Parehong apelido, Cruz.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Mag-asawa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Mag-asawa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: These are interlocking directors of the various companies mentioned. Whether it's Davao Bounty, Great Jolly, Great Jolly Times, Times Square B, GenCorp, diba? So, ganyan. Ano pong relasyon nila?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Spouses, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Asawa po ni Jaime si Richie. Si Kimberly po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Anak po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Si Nathan Zachary po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Anak din po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Si Girly po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No relation po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So Dela Cruz na siya, yung Cruz niya, walang relation sa Cruz nila. So yung tatlo lang po yung magkakamag-anak?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Apat.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Apat po, magkakamag-anak. So mag-asawa at nanay-tatay? Magkapatid?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sabi niyo po, binabayaran si VP Sara, nung accountant, sa halagang 2 million ng 22 to 25 dahil dun sa interest niya sa Davao Bounty. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nilagay po ng Vice President sa kanyang SALN noong 2007 na incorporator stockholder siya ng Davao Bounty. Noong 2013, nilagay na po niya na siya ay stockholder ng

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: ng Great Jolly Times, sorry, noong 2015. Sabi po dito, Great Jolly Times Food slash Times Square B Foods Corporation. Katulad lang po ng ginawa niya sa GenCorp. Nilagay din po niyang stockholder siya. Pero, sa pagkakaalam niyo, stockholder po ba siya ng dalawang kumpanyang to?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I will base it only on the articles of incorporation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Exactly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Based on that, is she a stockholder?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: She's not, right? She's

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: not, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: She's not a stockholder of Great Jolly Times Food Corporation and she's not a stockholder of Times Square B Foods Corporation, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Neither is she a stockholder of GenCorp Corporation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And yet, she placed all of these companies in her SALN as incorporator stockholder. Now, will it be reasonable for us to also assume that she was receiving something from these defunct corporations as well? Namely, Great Jolly Times Food Corporation and Times Square Food Corporation. Would you be aware of any such amounts received by the Vice President from these companies prior to GenCorp?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I am not aware if there were disbursements from those companies, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now, I'm still on this subject matter, ma'am. Tinayo yung Jollibee sa Times Square ng 2007, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Never napunta sa Davao Bounty yung prangkisa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: That is correct, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ano po ang kailangan bayaran ng Great Jolly Times sa Davao Bounty kung hindi naman sa kanya napunta yung prangkisa? Sa kanya po ba yung lease nung lugar?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: No, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi rin sa kanya yung prangkisa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: rin bahagi si VP Sara ng Great Jolly Times bagaman nilagay niya sa SALN niya. So ano po yung kailangang pagbayaran at ano po yung investment na pinasa-pasa o minana-mana ng mga kumpanya na hindi nasama ang pangalan ng VP dun sa mga kumpanya ngayon, namely Great Jolly Times, Times Square, and GenCorp later on. What exactly is the consideration for these monies being given to her?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: For the consideration, Your Honor, I do not know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ma

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: 'am, you are very specific. You mentioned it is for the Davao bounty. Yes. So what is the interest of Davao bounty in all of this? When they do not own the lease, they do not own the franchise, so what's the whole point in compensating Davao bounty?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: To my understanding, Your Honor, is the investment in the form of contributions she may have made before the operations of Great Jolly Times.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: agree, but ibang kompanya yun eh. Hindi naman siya bahagi ng Great Jolly Times, ma'am eh. Again, nilagay niya na sa Stockholder Incorporated pero hindi siya bahagi nun ayon sa GIS.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ano po yung binili, binayaran ng Great Jolly Times? Ano po yung binili, binayaran kung meron man ng Times Square? Ano po yung binabayaran hanggang noong 2025 at least ng GenCorp? Didn't it raise a big question mark on your part?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: It did, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, sabi mo hindi sa kanya yung prangkisa, hindi sa kanya yung lease. So, what is it for, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: I cannot pinpoint for certain kung ano. So, based sa inquiry and

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Those

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: were the expenses before nag-operate ang Jollibee.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: But this was way back in 2007, ma'am. And the only evidence you've given us is amounts given in 2022 to 2025. Again, I'm assuming na malamang mula noong 2007 pa din to. This is quite a serious allegation, ma'am, from a different perspective. The vice president during different times in her career was a public officer. So why would she be receiving monies from a private corporation that she has no interest in?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi po ba? Yung period na in question, dala niyo po yung sa accountant, yung 2022 to 2025, you just testified under oath that she was receiving monies from a private corporation in relation to a company she owned way back in 2007. that has no ownership over a franchise, no leasehold rights over the property where the Jollibee is located, and yet she is receiving money from a private corporation. I think it behooves on your part, especially given that you are a witness for the defense, to kindly explain via the submission of documents requested by Senator Judge Erwin and the Presiding Officer What these monies are for? In order to clear the air and to prove that these are not illegal or in any way violative of any laws. Do you agree, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. So we will still issue the subpoena, ma'am? You need it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: We will do so, ma'am. And we will just send it to you via... Do we have your email, ma'am? Can we just send it via email?

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: My subpoena was sent through email.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now... That would be all, ma'am. If there are no other interjections from the senator judges, we will excuse you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Suzette, salamat po. Paumanhin, at least hindi kayo inabot ng pitong oras. 6 hours and 50 minutes lang. Salamat po sa inyong panahon, oras. At gayon din, pagsagot at pagtugon sa mga katanungan mula sa senator judges at mula sa magkabilang partido.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You are excused, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before we excuse you, kindly consult your clients first. If you can submit it to us voluntarily, those two sets of documents. How it was booked and the return checks. Now, if you convey to us that you need a subpoena based on your discussions with your client, GenCorp, then we will issue the subpoena. But we will try to afford you the opportunity for us to do it from your end.

turns.speaker: Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay
turns.text: Very well, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Atty. Sujet.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: we adjourn, with the indulgence of Atty. Mike and Atty. and Hon. Ridon, we would like to inform the Senator Judges, particularly Sen. Judge Aquino, and Hontiveros. The court is in receipt via email of copies of the following documents from Engineer Adelin. Detailed: number one, details of his travels to China from 2025 and 2026, including A) travel authorities issued by the DILG Secretary and the Davao City Administrator, B) copy of Engineer Adelin's Chinese visa stamped in his passport, and C) official receipt of the visa application. And number two, Certification of records regarding properties declared for tax purposes under the names of Vice President Sara Duterte and Manases Carpio. The clerk is directed to furnish the senator judges and the parties with a copy of Engineer Adelin's submissions. So ordered.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Honorable Ridon, anything?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Panghuli na lang po. Yung pong mga kopya po ng mga dokumento ng mga in-identify po nung testigo kanina.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Atty. Mike, can you furnish them with copies of the documents?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. I believe there's a scheduled marking for today as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes. I didn't know that, but yes. Yes, there is. Clerk of Court confirms. Anything, Attorney Mike?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Just administrative matter.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: We just wanted to inform and manifest before this honorable court that for tomorrow, in the interest of time, and we don't want to waste the time of the court and to abbreviate the proceedings, we will be dispensing with the testimonies representing the bank representatives except for the BPI bank representative, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So all the bank reps except BPI?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Except BPI, Your Honor. Just to abbreviate the proceedings.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So who will be our witnesses tomorrow, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Tomorrow, Your Honor, it will be from BPI. I believe it's Attorney Ismael, the SVP for Legal, followed, Your Honor, by Mr. Chad... Mr. Arnel Entero.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Isn't it? How about Attorney Cesar Bernard Coloma of BPI? We don't

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: need Attorney Coloma anymore, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So just Attorney Ismael?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And then next would be?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: And then in the order stated in the manifestation, which is I think, Mr. Chad?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: That's correct, Your Honor. Sorry. It will be after BPI, it would be Attorney Anel Antero, followed by Mr. Chadrin Parian, and City Prosecutor Vimar Barcellano.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay, so, Atty. Ismael, Antero, Parian, and Barcelliana?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: City Prosecutor Vimar Barcellano

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: That is all for the defense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Did you get that at Honorable Ridon?

turns.speaker: Rep. Terry L. Ridon
turns.text: Yes, we had made notes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you. The Senator, judges are likewise equally informed. There being no other matters to be taken up, at least we get to adjourn before 6 p.m. This is our latest, I believe, since we started. Is that correct, Atty. Mike?

turns.speaker: Atty. Michael Wesley Poa
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I believe this is our latest so let's make sure we don't make it reach 6 p.m. There being no other matters, trial is adjourned until 10 a.m. of tomorrow, Thursday, November 12, 2026.
